title: Create and Troubleshoot an Enterprise Security Detection
objectives: Create and Troubleshoot an Enterprise Security Detection
Demonstrate actual outcomes and independently inspect evidence.

tasks.instruction: The fixture has three normalized events. Add the notable events index through cm01’s native manager bundle, preserving existing definitions. On sh01 create an App-shared canonical alert named Authentication failure detection, owner admin. Search index=ops_logs tag=authentication action=failure | stats count by user.

Use custom condition search count > 1, per-result mode (digest off), suppression 5m by user, tracking enabled, and the notable action. Execute it twice over the same range: one real notable should be followed by one suppressed repeat. Open Interview workbench → Recorded security operations, inspect actual result rows/source revision, assign it and save an investigation note. Independently search index=notable source="Authentication failure detection" | stats count. This bounded detection path does not install Enterprise Security.

hints: Inspect running source and actual receipts before changing configuration.
Use the paused fixture clock deliberately; verify results through a separate view or query.
